up: For all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513217, return the exact activity values (standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units) and the canonical SMILES of the compound.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513217')
